allowed_retry: Retry only the exact href path and query on the same iwdb.nceas.ucsb.edu host that served the database entry. Filename, path and query are unchanged; only the stale host component is replaced.
blocked_after_retry: If the exact-path IWDB-host retry does not return the workbook bytes, retain the Mahé source block. Do not use a secondary reanalysis or reconstructed network values.
claim_boundary: Transport-only amendment made before any workbook or v9 target is recovered.
